title: 第69章 属于林墨的时代
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
金銮殿上，一片死寂。

林墨看着倒在血泊中的武太后，心中，没有半分波澜。

他知道，从这一刻起，大乾王朝，将迎来一个全新时代。

一个，由他开创的时代。

武太后自尽，九王爷伏诛，京城叛乱，一夜荡平。

当黎明的曙光，再次照亮这座古老的都城时，一切尘埃落定。

洛无笙的双颊本就因滚烫而变得有些红润，在反应过来第五墨的话后，微红润的脸颊红得如同熟透了的柿子。

严逸在听到这一声破空的声音之后，顿时汗毛诈欺，冷汗不由自主的从毛孔之中钻了出来，与此同时严逸处于动物的本能反应，向着一旁闪躲了一下，险之又险的躲过了对方的匕首。

虽然自己的种子是意外得来，而且对方要的也只是很少的一部分，可唐林依旧非常的心疼。

看着林凤神色痛苦咬紧银牙，苏木二话不说，抱住林凤的玉体放在草地上，抬起林凤受伤流血的修长如玉的细腿，嘴巴吸了过去。

于萌因为后来的两个客人耽误了点儿时间，再加上她回家之前又给警局打了电话，才晚回来一些。

起初，他并未在意，以为是水草什么东西之类的。可接下来，当他抬眼一看的时候，脸都吓白了。吴争赫然看见了，在河上漂着的，是一团破旧衣服。而被衣服包裹的那一团东西，竟然有皮肤裸露而出。

很明显，能够获得种子规则的认可，这就代表着这个格鲁有着相对应的天才手段，巧的是他已经说了，如果唐林能够救治他的母亲，他愿意献出生命，所以在唐林看来，这个任务已经完成了。

她动作麻利的将碗筷拿到铁锅旁边舀了一点儿热的煮面汤刷好，又用干净的冷水涮了一遍，才放在旁边。

如果这时有淬体境修为的人存在，一定会被眼下发生的事情，吓的六神无主，因为这种凭空出现的传送光幕，别说是他们，就是更高一层存在的强者，都没有这样的神通，可见老者的修为，到底有多么骇人听闻。

不过这黑白的颜色，却是一下子让曳戈想起了，自己在幻境中曳戈看到的“师父”和正三宗主身上衣服的颜色，当然这些都无关紧要。

姜越哥？姜笑笑有些疑惑地打量着颜姗姗，确实有几分眼熟，但这么嚣张跋扈蛮横无理的姑娘到底是谁？印象中，姜越哥没跟她提过认识这号人物。

李常娥打了个冷颤，被看的毛骨悚然，那种恐惧是从骨子里透出来的。

这种事，他们两个老家伙没必要掺和。依照顾简繁的性格，不会看着让乔乔吃亏的。

本身长门是打算离开凤凰城的，因为这个地方虽说有不少高手，这些高手还是在普通人眼中那种无法去真正触及的高手。

乌发随风轻扬，黑眸荧荧如泉，那张如画清颜，风采清越、贵气逼人。眼前的皇甫贤，仿佛地狱而生的妖孽，睥睨万物，众佛难挡。没有丝毫的弱点，完美地找不到一点瑕丝和破绽。让人心中不由自主地腾起一股寒意。

什么？颜萧萧触电般坐起来，顾不得换睡衣，她匆匆走过去拉开门。

楚傲天大怒，双手捧着她的脸扬起来，这里可是野外，随时有人经过。

“七皇子，是绿儿的错，绿儿不是故意的，是无心的……”夏绿不敢隐瞒了，只能承认，她边说边观察景流云的表情，可是他的脸上没有任何表情，波澜不惊，这让夏绿更是忐忑。
content_en:
There was deathly silence in the Jinluan Hall.

Lin Mo looked at Empress Dowager Wu lying in a pool of blood, and there was no wave in his heart.

He knew that from this moment on, the Daqian Dynasty would usher in a new era.

An era created by him.

Empress Dowager Wu committed suicide, and the Nine Princes executed her. The rebellion in the capital was wiped out overnight.

When the dawn illuminated this ancient capital again, everything settled.

Luo Wusheng's cheeks were already a little rosy due to the heat. After reacting to Wu Mo's words, the slightly rosy cheeks turned as red as a ripe persimmon.

After Yan Yi heard the sound of breaking through the air, his hair suddenly became deceptive, and cold sweat involuntarily came out of his pores. At the same time, Yan Yi acted on his animal instinct and dodged to the side, narrowly dodging the opponent's dagger.

Although his seed was obtained by accident, and the other party only wanted a small part, Tang Lin still felt very distressed.

Seeing Lin Feng clenching her teeth in pain, Su Mu hugged Lin Feng's jade body and placed it on the grass without saying a word, lifted Lin Feng's injured and bleeding slender jade-like legs, and sucked it in with her mouth.

Yu Meng was delayed a little by the two later guests, and she called the police station before going home, so she came back later.

At first, he didn't pay much attention, thinking it was waterweed or something like that.But then, when he looked up, his face turned pale with fright.Wu Zheng suddenly saw a pile of shabby clothes floating on the river.And the mass wrapped in clothes actually had exposed skin.

Obviously, being recognized by the Seed Rules means that Gru has corresponding genius methods. Coincidentally, he has already said that if Tang Lin can save his mother, he is willing to sacrifice his life, so in Tang Lin's view, this task has been completed.

She quickly took the bowl and chopsticks to the iron pot, scooped out some hot noodle soup, rinsed it with clean cold water, and then put it aside.

If there were people who had cultivated in the Body Tempering Realm at this time, they would definitely be frightened by what was happening, because this kind of teleportation light curtain appeared out of thin air. Not to mention them, even the powerful people who existed at a higher level did not have such magical powers. This shows how appalling the old man's cultivation is.

However, the black and white color suddenly reminded Yi Ge of the "master" he saw in the illusion and the color of the clothes on the Zhengsan Sect Master. Of course, these are irrelevant.

Brother Jiang Yue?Jiang Xiaoxiao looked at Yan Shanshan with some doubts. She did look familiar, but who was such an arrogant, domineering, unreasonable and unreasonable girl?In the impression, Brother Jiang Yue never mentioned to her that he knew this person.

Li Chang'e shuddered, the sight of her hair standing on end, the fear radiating from her bones.

There is no need for the two old guys to get involved in this kind of thing.Depending on Jian Fan's character, he would not let Qiao Qiao suffer.

Nagato himself planned to leave Phoenix City, because although there were many masters in this place, these masters were still the kind of masters that ordinary people could not really touch.

Her black hair is blowing in the wind, her black eyes are as bright as springs, and her picturesque face is full of elegance and nobility.The Huangfu Xian in front of him was like a monster born from hell, looking down at all things and making it difficult for all Buddhas to stop him.There is no weakness at all, no flaw or flaw can be found in it.It makes people feel a chill in their hearts.

What?Yan Xiaoxiao sat up as if she was electrocuted. Without even bothering to change into her pajamas, she hurried over and opened the door.

Chu Aotian was furious, holding her face in his hands and raising it. This was a wild place, and someone could pass by at any time.

"Seventh Prince, it's Lu'er's fault. Lu'er didn't do it on purpose, it was unintentional..." Xia Lu didn't dare to hide it anymore. She could only admit that she observed Jing Liuyun's expression as she spoke, but there was no expression on his face and was calm, which made Xia Lu even more uneasy.
